name: Simple AutoSprint
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: pulaskin
description: Auto sprint / toggle sprint: press V once and you sprint whenever you move forward, no holding or double-tapping Ctrl. Client-side, no jitter against walls. Fabric, Forge & NeoForge for Minecraft 1.12.2–26.3.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: V toggles auto sprint (you sprint whenever you move forward with food above 6) and says 'Автобег: ВКЛ' (on, green) or 'Автобег: ВЫКЛ' (off, red) on the action bar.
note: Not yet: the try checks the toggle's answers, not the sprinting itself
